audience: Creators planning and publishing social posts from LinkSelf
signature: A wide glass frame with a 72px labelled category rail, one-row calendar toolbar and a narrow schedule edge.
rationale: The owner-approved compact app addendum uses 16px desktop margins, 12px rail labels and 36px controls in the existing Figtree and azure identity. Studio category tabs sit below each page title, with Settings retaining its own second pill row; the five main destinations fit equal phone columns and active category tabs scroll into view. Settings uses content-height tiles; editor channel settings expand one row at a time with a live destination count. Source attribution remains discoverable in the footer. Theme overrides are gated to LinkSelf; upstream installs and native network simulations retain their appearance. The shared server-rendered frame keeps the viewport-height rail and identity header in place while empty calendar tiles reserve the loaded workspace geometry.
